events.text: I’ve forgotten the PIN for my H&V debit card and need to use it again. Please tell me the safe way to deal with this; I won’t send my PIN in chat.
I’m escalating HV-026 for the prescribed PIN route. The required customer check is complete in the secure portal; I have not asked for or recorded a PIN.
The prescribed PIN procedure is available for this case. Please open it for the checked customer in the secure portal; the PIN must not be sent in correspondence.
I’ve opened the prescribed PIN procedure for you in the secure portal, following the completed check. Please continue through that procedure there; I cannot see your PIN.

summary: Maren Ellwood wrote in secure chat that she had forgotten her debit card PIN and asked for the safe way to deal with it. The desk classed it as an access request about a card and found that the bank had already opened the prescribed PIN procedure for her in the secure portal. It took no action and closed the case as waiting, since nothing more can happen until she uses that procedure. The desk's own attempt to send a reply was refused because the case was already in the waiting state, so no reply went out from the desk, and nothing is left for a person unless she does not complete the portal steps.
